description: Social Engineering Village at DEF CON 27 covers the human aspects of security, from reconnaissance and pretexting to insider threats and organizational culture. The 18 talks explore both attack techniques and defensive awareness.

talks.title: R Paul Wilson
talks.teaser: Opening keynote from renowned social engineer and security researcher R Paul Wilson at DEF CON 27.

talks.title: RED TEAMING FROM DOWN UNDER
talks.teaser: Red team operations from an international perspective—techniques and methodologies from down under applied to modern security assessments.

talks.title: The SEPodcast Ep 120 Live Guest Robin Dreeke
talks.teaser: Live podcast episode featuring Robin Dreeke discussing rapport building, behavioral analysis, and defensive social engineering strategies.

talks.title: OSINT in the Real World
talks.teaser: Practical OSINT techniques applicable to security careers and daily life—real investigation walkthroughs and personal case studies.

talks.title: Why vigilantism doesnt work
talks.teaser: Discussion on the limitations and dangers of vigilantism in child protection—why systemic approaches beat individual action.

talks.title: Leveraging the Insider Threat
talks.teaser: Insider threat exploitation techniques—manipulating employees to steal data, equipment, or commit sabotage from within an organization.

talks.title: Red Teaming Insights and Examples from Beyond
talks.teaser: Red team approaches beyond penetration testing—how military, intelligence, and private sector organizations use red teaming for strategic defense.

talks.title: The Aspies Guide to Social Engineering
talks.teaser: Neurodivergent perspectives on social engineering—how autism and different thinking styles bring unique strengths to security defense.

talks.title: Hacking Your Career Thru Social Engineering
talks.teaser: Using social engineering principles for career growth—blending technical skills with human behavior understanding for professional success.

talks.title: Sizing People Up
talks.teaser: Advanced people-reading techniques—assessing personality, trust signals, and building rapport through behavioral analysis.

talks.title: Swing Away  Conquer Impostor Syndrome
talks.teaser: Overcoming impostor syndrome—psychological barriers affecting security professionals and how to break through self-doubt cycles.

talks.title: SEVillage 10 Year Anniversary a Look Back
talks.teaser: Retrospective on 10 years of Social Engineering Village—evolution from underground gatherings to mainstream security awareness.

talks.title: Psychic Cold Reading Techniques
talks.teaser: Cold reading techniques for extracting information and building false credibility—how to make targets believe you possess knowledge about them.

talks.title: The Basics of Social Engineering
talks.teaser: Fundamentals of social engineering for beginners—you don't need to be charismatic or outgoing to succeed as a social engineer.

talks.title: The Voice Told Me To Do It
talks.teaser: Voice-based social engineering—leveraging authority and psychological pressure to manipulate victims into compliance.

talks.title: Rideshare OSINT Car-Based SE For Fun and Profit
talks.teaser: OSINT and social engineering via rideshare interactions—gathering intelligence and testing security through Uber and Lyft engagements.

talks.title: I PWN thee I PWN thee not
talks.teaser: Control failure analysis—why most defensive implementations fail and how attackers exploit misunderstood security risks.

talks.title: Hacking Hollywood
talks.teaser: Entertainment industry security failures—lessons from high-profile breaches and vulnerabilities specific to content production.
